name: musashi RNA binding protein 2

function.text: MSI2 encodes RNA-binding protein Musashi homolog 2. Annotated molecular activities include mRNA binding. It participates in regulation of translation and stem cell development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: MSI2 encodes Musashi-2, an RNA-binding protein that regulates expression of target messenger RNAs at the level of translation. It may also contribute to proliferation and maintenance of nervous-system stem cells, an assignment supported in part by similarity. Its direct molecular role concerns handling of RNA and protein synthesis rather than transcriptional control through DNA binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MSI2 have been reported in neuroblastoma.
